news.title: Utah Mammoth beat the Oilers 4-2 as Clayton Keller scores twice

news.description: — Clayton Keller scored a pair of goals and the Utah Mammoth snapped Edmonton's five-game win streak with a 4-2 victory over the Oilers on Thursday night.

news.title: Celebrini scores lone shootout goal to lift the Sharks past the Predators 3-2
news.ruTitle: Селебрини забил единственный гол в серии пенальти и помог «Шаркс» обыграть «Хищников» со счетом 3–2.
news.description: — Macklin Celebrini scored the only goal of a shootout to give the San Jose Sharks a 3-2 victory over the Nashville Predators on Thursday night.

news.title: Red Wings send Flyers to franchise record-extending 9th straight loss to start season
news.ruTitle: «Ред Уингз» отправили «Флайерз» в франшизу с рекордным девятым поражением подряд в начале сезона
news.description: — Andrew Copp broke a tie with 4:38 left and the Detroit Red Wings sent the Philadelphia Flyers to their franchise record-extending ninth straight loss to start the season, winning 2-1 on Thursday night.

news.title: Owen Power scores in OT to complete Sabres' rally for 5-4 win over Maple Leafs
news.ruTitle: Оуэн Пауэр забивает в овертайме и завершает розыгрыш "Сэйбрз" над победой со счетом 5:4 над "Мэйпл Лифс"
news.description: — Owen Power scored in overtime and the Buffalo Sabres rallied from two goals down in the third period to overcome Kirill Marchenko's hat trick and beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 5-4 on Thursday.

news.title: Brady Tkachuk completes his 2nd straight natural hat trick in OT as Panthers stun Canucks

news.description: — Brady Tkachuk completed his second straight natural hat trick with a nifty move up the middle in overtime to give the Florida Panthers a 3-2 victory over the Vancouver Canucks on Thursday night.

news.title: Blackhawks' Kane sets record for assists by U.S.-born player
